apps.message:
fix(test): skip the container test without Docker; keep the browser notice out of the check's error

## Intent

The tests failed on a machine without a Docker daemon and with an older Chromium. A test that needs Docker should skip where there is none, and the browser fallback should not hide the real error of a check.

## Key changes

- The review test that builds in the workflow's container runs docker info once and skips when there is no daemon.
- A listing finding for a check that stopped no longer takes the first line of its stderr blindly. It skips the notices about the fallback Chromium, so the finding names the actual error, for example ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.
